headline: After going public, Voyah releases its first half-year report: technical service revenue grows nearly 6-fold, turns to a loss of 389 million yuan due to rising raw material prices
summary: Voyah, now publicly listed, reported technical service revenue up nearly sixfold. It posted a loss of 389 million yuan due to rising raw material prices.
why: Voyah is a Chinese electric vehicle brand, and raw material costs such as battery metals are central to EV margins.

original_headline: 岚图上市后发布首份半年报：技术服务收入增长近6倍，受原材料涨价影响转亏3.89亿元
